shimNotes.CollectStrategy.deviceBasedStrategy: The crate takes a strategy by name (sharingStrategy in encryptionSettings, shareStrategy in encryptToDeviceEvent). Map deviceBasedStrategy(onlyAllowTrustedDevices, errorOnVerifiedUserProblem) in WASM's order: onlyAllowTrustedDevices true gives onlyTrustedDevices (whatever the second flag); otherwise errorOnVerifiedUserProblem true gives errorOnUnverifiedUserProblem; otherwise allDevices. A wrong mapping shares room keys with unverified devices; scripts/native-crypto-trust.test.mjs pins all four combinations against WASM.
